arguments.summary: The pgbouncer service is currently degraded, with 100 connections in use and no worker throughput. The failed_jobs table in the jobs database, which has been accumulating failures all week, is being exported using pg_dump as requested. This process is expected to take approximately 20 minutes.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Monitor the pgbouncer service and the failed_jobs export. Once the export is complete, review the data to identify the root cause of the failed jobs and take corrective actions.
